blocks.label: Reset watchdog
blocks.prompt:
Persistent reset watchdog for this request:

{{input}}

On the first turn call ai_usage for codex, select the earliest future reset timestamp exposed by account_quota.primary.resets_at, account_quota.secondary.resets_at, or resets_at, then call timer_set_at with that exact ISO timestamp. If no reset is exposed, use timer_set for 300 seconds. Do not start work before the timer.

When revived, call workflow_run_stack exactly once on the connected Feature planner with a self-contained prompt containing the complete original request and the words RESET_ELAPSED. Wait for the planner result, then call ai_usage again and schedule the next exact reset timer. Always schedule the next timer, including after completion or errors. Never create tasks directly in this block.
